name: Verify a release, then merge the held pull request
description: Every 10 minutes it looks at the repository's newest releases. Two and a half hours after one is published, it checks that the release is not a draft or a pre-release and that its update manifest is among the assets, and tells the leader what it found. When the release is good, a card asks you to merge the one pull request that was held for it; only your yes merges it.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The GitHub repository whose releases to watch, as owner/name.

credential.title: Vault entry
credential.description: The id of the Vault entry that holds a GitHub token that can read the releases and merge the pull request. The first call asks you once; the token goes only to api.github.com.

manifest_asset.title: The update manifest
manifest_asset.description: The file name of the release asset that must be there for the release to count as good, such as latest.json. Leave out quote marks.

held_pr.title: The held pull request
held_pr.description: The number of the pull request that waits for this release and is merged when you say yes.

leader.title: Who to tell
leader.description: The id of the agent that gets one line about each release.
